title: China Winter Travel Map
synopsis: Experience a winter wonderland in northeast China. This article recommends Jilin’s snow-covered trees as well as Harbin’s beautiful scenery and famous Ice and Snow Festival as great destinations for winter travel.

fullText.simplified:
中国冬季旅游地图

    冬天是一个安静的季节，但在中国东北，冬天不是这样的。中国东北是中国冬天最冷和时间最长的地方，这里从每年11月到第二年的三、四月都会下雪。虽然下雪的时间很长，但这里的人却非常热情，他们把雪和冰变成了艺术品。如果你想看这些艺术品，或者想去滑雪，可以去这几个城市看看。
    吉林省吉林市的雪树非常有名。吉林有一条河，冬天的时候，河边的树上都是雪。在蓝天和白雪下，这些雪树都漂亮极了。其实这些“雪树”上的雪不是真的雪，是白色的霜。因为天气太冷了，但是河里的水是热的，空气里的热水遇到冷的树，就会变成“雪树”的样子。
    最不能错过的是哈尔滨的冬天。哈尔滨在黑龙江省，这里以前是东北最大的城市。所以，这里的房子漂亮极了，中国的、外国的都有，你可以在一个城市里看到不同国家的房子。到了冬天冰雪节，哈尔滨人会把雪做成不同的样子，也会把灯放在冰里，做成冰灯。到了晚上，好看极了。人们在晚上出来，看冰灯、滑雪、吃好吃的。哈尔滨人的热情，会让人忘了天气的冷。在哈尔滨吃饭，不要点太多菜，因为每个菜都很多。
    如果你只想滑雪，除了东北，还可以去河北张家口。张家口离北京很近，有很多滑雪场。这儿的天气没有东北那么冷，但每年还是有五个月时间可以滑雪，是一个滑雪的好地方。
    说到这里，还只是开始。中国的冬天，北方和南方是不一样的，东边和西边也不一样。欢迎你在冬天来中国看看！
fullText.traditional:
中國冬季旅遊地圖

    冬天是一個安靜的季節，但在中國東北，冬天不是這樣的。中國東北是中國冬天最冷和時間最長的地方，這裡從每年11月到第二年的三、四月都會下雪。雖然下雪的時間很長，但這裡的人卻非常熱情，他們把雪和冰變成了藝術品。如果你想看這些藝術品，或者想去滑雪，可以去這幾個城市看看。
    吉林省吉林市的雪樹非常有名。吉林有一條河，冬天的時候，河邊的樹上都是雪。在藍天和白雪下，這些雪樹都漂亮極了。其實這些“雪樹”上的雪不是真的雪，是白色的霜。因為天氣太冷了，但是河裡的水是熱的，空氣裡的熱水遇到冷的樹，就會變成“雪樹”的樣子。
    最不能錯過的是哈爾濱的冬天。哈爾濱在黑龍江省，這裡以前是東北最大的城市。所以，這裡的房子漂亮極了，中國的、外國的都有，你可以在一個城市裡看到不同國家的房子。到了冬天冰雪節，哈爾濱人會把雪做成不同的樣子，也會把燈放在冰裡，做成冰燈。到了晚上，好看極了。人們在晚上出來，看冰燈、滑雪、吃好吃的。哈爾濱人的熱情，會讓人忘了天氣的冷。在哈爾濱吃飯，不要點太多菜，因為每個菜都很多。
    如果你只想滑雪，除了東北，還可以去河北張家口。張家口離北京很近，有很多滑雪場。這兒的天氣沒有東北那麼冷，但每年還是有五個月時間可以滑雪，是一個滑雪的好地方。
    說到這裡，還只是開始。中國的冬天，北方和南方是不一樣的，東邊和西邊也不一樣。歡迎你在冬天來中國看看！

sentences.simplified: 冬天是一个安静的季节，但在中国东北，冬天不是这样的。
sentences.traditional: 冬天是一個安靜的季節，但在中國東北，冬天不是這樣的。

sentences.simplified: 中国东北是中国冬天最冷和时间最长的地方，
sentences.traditional: 中國東北是中國冬天最冷和時間最長的地方，
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó dōng běi shì zhōng guó dōng tiān zuì lěng hé shí jiān zuì cháng de dì fang
sentences.english: Winter is a quiet season, but in northeast China, winter is not like that.

sentences.simplified: 这里从每年11月到第二年的三、四月都会下雪。
sentences.traditional: 這裡從每年11月到第二年的三、四月都會下雪。
sentences.pinyin: zhè lǐ cóng měi nián 2 yuè dào dì èr nián de sān sì yuè dōu huì xià xuě
sentences.english: Northeast China has the coldest and longest winters in China.

sentences.simplified: 虽然下雪的时间很长，但这里的人却非常热情，
sentences.traditional: 雖然下雪的時間很長，但這裡的人卻非常熱情，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán xià xuě de shí jiān hěn cháng dàn zhè lǐ de rén què fēi cháng rè qíng
sentences.english: Here, it snows every year from November until March or April of the following year.

sentences.simplified: 他们把雪和冰变成了艺术品。
sentences.traditional: 他們把雪和冰變成了藝術品。
sentences.pinyin: tā men bǎ xuě hé bīng biàn chéng le yì shù pǐn
sentences.english: Although the snowfall lasts for a long time, the people here are very enthusiastic.

sentences.simplified: 如果你想看这些艺术品，或者想去滑雪，可以去这几个城市看看。
sentences.traditional: 如果你想看這些藝術品，或者想去滑雪，可以去這幾個城市看看。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng kàn zhè xiē yì shù pǐn huò zhě xiǎng qù huá xuě kě yǐ qù zhè jǐ ge chéng shì kàn kan
sentences.english: They turn the snow and ice into works of art.
If you want to see these works of art, or if you want to go skiing, you can visit these cities.

sentences.simplified: 吉林省吉林市的雪树非常有名。
sentences.traditional: 吉林省吉林市的雪樹非常有名。
sentences.pinyin: jí lín shěng jí lín shì de xuě shù fēi cháng yǒu míng

sentences.simplified: 吉林有一条河，冬天的时候，河边的树上都是雪。
sentences.traditional: 吉林有一條河，冬天的時候，河邊的樹上都是雪。
sentences.pinyin: jí lín yǒu yì tiáo hé dōng tiān de shí hou hé biān de shù shang dōu shì xuě
sentences.english: Jilin City in Jilin Province is very famous for its snow-covered trees.

sentences.simplified: 在蓝天和白雪下，这些雪树都漂亮极了。
sentences.traditional: 在藍天和白雪下，這些雪樹都漂亮極了。
sentences.pinyin: zài lán tiān hé bái xuě xià zhè xiē xuě shù dōu piào liang jí le
sentences.english: There is a river in Jilin, and in the winter, the trees along the river are all covered in snow.

sentences.simplified: 其实这些“雪树”上的雪不是真的雪，是白色的霜。
sentences.traditional: 其實這些“雪樹”上的雪不是真的雪，是白色的霜。
sentences.pinyin: qí shí zhè xiē xuě shù shang de xuě bú shì zhēn de xuě shì bái sè de shuāng
sentences.english: Under the blue skies and white snow, these snow-covered trees are very beautiful.

sentences.simplified: 因为天气太冷了，但是河里的水是热的，
sentences.traditional: 因為天氣太冷了，但是河裡的水是熱的，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi tiān qì tài lěng le dàn shì hé lǐ de shuǐ shì rè de
sentences.english: In fact, these “snow-covered trees” aren’t covered in snow but rather in white frost.

sentences.simplified: 空气里的热水遇到冷的树，就会变成“雪树”的样子。
sentences.traditional: 空氣裡的熱水遇到冷的樹，就會變成“雪樹”的樣子。
sentences.pinyin: kōng qì lǐ de rè shuǐ yù dào lěng de shù jiù huì biàn chéng xuě shù de yàng zi
sentences.english: The weather is cold, but the water in the river is hot, ..
.. so when the hot water in the air meets the trees, the trees turn into “snow-covered trees”.

sentences.simplified: 最不能错过的是哈尔滨的冬天。
sentences.traditional: 最不能錯過的是哈爾濱的冬天。
sentences.pinyin: zuì bù néng cuò guò de shì hā ěr bīn de dōng tiān

sentences.simplified: 哈尔滨在黑龙江省，这里以前是东北最大的城市。
sentences.traditional: 哈爾濱在黑龍江省，這裡以前是東北最大的城市。
sentences.pinyin: hā ěr bīn zài hēi lóng jiāng shěng zhè lǐ yǐ qián shì dōng běi zuì dà de chéng shì
sentences.english: Something that absolutely cannot be missed is the winter in Harbin.

sentences.simplified: 所以，这里的房子漂亮极了，
sentences.traditional: 所以，這裡的房子漂亮極了，
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ zhè lǐ de fáng zi piào liang jí le
sentences.english: Harbin is located in Heilongjiang Province and used to be the largest city in northeast China.

sentences.simplified: 中国的、外国的都有，你可以在一个城市里看到不同国家的房子。
sentences.traditional: 中國的、外國的都有，你可以在一個城市裡看到不同國家的房子。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó de wài guó de dōu yǒu nǐ kě yǐ zài yí ge chéng shì lǐ kàn dào bù tóng guó jiā de fáng zi
sentences.english: So, the houses here are very beautiful.

sentences.simplified: 到了冬天冰雪节，哈尔滨人会把雪做成不同的样子，
sentences.traditional: 到了冬天冰雪節，哈爾濱人會把雪做成不同的樣子，
sentences.pinyin: dào le dōng tiān bīng xuě jié hā ěr bīn rén huì bǎ xuě zuò chéng bù tóng de yàng zi
sentences.english: There are Chinese ones, and also foreign ones. You can see houses from different countries in one city.

sentences.simplified: 也会把灯放在冰里，做成冰灯。到了晚上，好看极了。
sentences.traditional: 也會把燈放在冰裡，做成冰燈。到了晚上，好看極了。
sentences.pinyin: yě huì bǎ dēng fàng zài bīng lǐ zuò chéng bīng dēng dào le wǎn shang hǎo kàn jí le
sentences.english: When the winter Ice and Snow Festival arrives, Harbin locals create various shapes out of snow.

sentences.simplified: 人们在晚上出来，看冰灯、滑雪、吃好吃的。
sentences.traditional: 人們在晚上出來，看冰燈、滑雪、吃好吃的。
sentences.pinyin: rén men zài wǎn shang chū lái kàn bīng dēng huá xuě chī hǎo chī de
sentences.english: They also put lights in ice to make ice lanterns. They look very beautiful at night.

sentences.simplified: 哈尔滨人的热情，会让人忘了天气的冷。
sentences.traditional: 哈爾濱人的熱情，會讓人忘了天氣的冷。
sentences.pinyin: hā ěr bīn rén de rè qíng huì ràng rén wàng le tiān qì de lěng
sentences.english: People come out at night to look at ice lanterns, ski, and eat good food.

sentences.simplified: 在哈尔滨吃饭，不要点太多菜，因为每个菜都很多。
sentences.traditional: 在哈爾濱吃飯，不要點太多菜，因為每個菜都很多。
sentences.pinyin: zài hā ěr bīn chī fàn bú yào diǎn tài duō cài yīn wèi měi ge cài dōu hěn duō
sentences.english: The enthusiasm of the people of Harbin makes people forget about the cold weather.
When eating in Harbin, don’t order too many dishes because each dish comes with large portions.

sentences.simplified: 如果你只想滑雪，除了东北，还可以去河北张家口。
sentences.traditional: 如果你只想滑雪，除了東北，還可以去河北張家口。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ zhǐ xiǎng huá xuě chú le dōng běi hái kě yǐ qù hé běi zhāng jiā kǒu

sentences.simplified: 张家口离北京很近，有很多滑雪场。
sentences.traditional: 張家口離北京很近，有很多滑雪場。
sentences.pinyin: zhāng jiā kǒu lí běi jīng hěn jìn yǒu hěn duō huá xuě chǎng
sentences.english: If you only want to ski, other than the northeast, you can also go to Zhangjiakou in Hebei.

sentences.simplified: 这儿的天气没有东北那么冷，但每年还是有五个月时间可以滑雪，是一个滑雪的好地方。
sentences.traditional: 這兒的天氣沒有東北那麼冷，但每年還是有五個月時間可以滑雪，是一個滑雪的好地方。
sentences.pinyin: zhè‘r de tiān qì méi yǒu dōng běi nà me lěng dàn měi nián hái shi yǒu wǔ ge yuè shí jiān kě yǐ huá xuě shì yí ge huá xuě de hǎo dì fang
sentences.english: Zhangjiakou is very close to Beijing and has many ski resorts.
The weather here isn’t as cold as in the northeast, but you can still ski five months out of every year. It’s a good place for skiing.

sentences.simplified: 说到这里，还只是开始。中国的冬天，北方和南方是不一样的，东边和西边也不一样。
sentences.traditional: 說到這裡，還只是開始。中國的冬天，北方和南方是不一樣的，東邊和西邊也不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: shuō dào zhè lǐ hái zhǐ shì kāi shǐ zhōng guó de dōng tiān běi fāng hé nán fāng shì bù yí yàng de dōng bian hé xī biān yě bù yí yàng

sentences.simplified: 欢迎你在冬天来中国看看！
sentences.traditional: 歡迎你在冬天來中國看看！
sentences.pinyin: huān yíng nǐ zài dōng tiān lái zhōng guó kàn kan
sentences.english: This is just the start. Winter in China in the north is different from the south, and the east is different from the west.

sentence_translations: China Winter Travel Map
Winter is a quiet season, but in northeast China, winter is not like that.
Northeast China has the coldest and longest winters in China.
Here, it snows every year from November until March or April of the following year.
Although the snowfall lasts for a long time, the people here are very enthusiastic.
They turn the snow and ice into works of art.
If you want to see these works of art, or if you want to go skiing, you can visit these cities.
Jilin City in Jilin Province is very famous for its snow-covered trees.
There is a river in Jilin, and in the winter, the trees along the river are all covered in snow.
Under the blue skies and white snow, these snow-covered trees are very beautiful.
In fact, these “snow-covered trees” aren’t covered in snow but rather in white frost.
The weather is cold, but the water in the river is hot, ..
.. so when the hot water in the air meets the trees, the trees turn into “snow-covered trees”.
Something that absolutely cannot be missed is the winter in Harbin.
Harbin is located in Heilongjiang Province and used to be the largest city in northeast China.
So, the houses here are very beautiful.
There are Chinese ones, and also foreign ones. You can see houses from different countries in one city.
When the winter Ice and Snow Festival arrives, Harbin locals create various shapes out of snow.
They also put lights in ice to make ice lanterns. They look very beautiful at night.
People come out at night to look at ice lanterns, ski, and eat good food.
The enthusiasm of the people of Harbin makes people forget about the cold weather.
When eating in Harbin, don’t order too many dishes because each dish comes with large portions.
If you only want to ski, other than the northeast, you can also go to Zhangjiakou in Hebei.
Zhangjiakou is very close to Beijing and has many ski resorts.
The weather here isn’t as cold as in the northeast, but you can still ski five months out of every year. It’s a good place for skiing.
This is just the start. Winter in China in the north is different from the south, and the east is different from the west.
We welcome you to visit China during the winter!
